### 👨‍💻 About Me

🔭 **Role:** Director of Engineering at **[Wazuh](https://github.com/wazuh/wazuh)**, leading engineering teams building open-source SIEM / XDR, threat detection, and vulnerability management platforms.

⚙️ **Focus:** High-performance systems programming, cross-platform endpoint security (Linux/POSIX & Kernel modules, Windows Win32 API, macOS), concurrency, and distributed architectures.

🛡️ **Domains:** Vulnerability Remediation (CVE, GHSA), FIM (File Integrity Monitoring), Cryptography (AES) & Threat Detection.

⚡ **Fun fact:** *Once I compiled assembly code on the first try.*

💬 **Ask me about:** Systems architecture, C/C++, performance optimization, cybersecurity, photography & music.
